description: This file defines the ChatFilter class which provides static methods for sanitizing chat messages and filtering allowed emoticons within a chat feature of a mobile app.

classes.name: ChatFilter
classes.description: A utility class for sanitizing chat text by trimming, collapsing whitespace, masking profanities, and managing allowed emoticons.

methods.name: sanitizeText
methods.description: Sanitizes a chat input string by trimming, collapsing whitespace, and masking common profanities to improve client-side safety.

methods.name: isAllowedEmote
methods.description: Checks if a given emoticon is in the allowed list.
